description: Web search with page content for AI agents: send keywords and get the top results with each page read as clean Markdown, in one call: title, URL, a short description and the page's text. Up to 5 results, each page cut at 20,000 characters. Pages that cannot be fetched are dropped and refunded. Pay per call in stablecoins. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

limit.description: number of results wanted, 1 to 5 (default 3). A larger value is lowered to 5 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

query.description: search keywords, e.g. "lithium prices" (not a URL)

name: web-search
title: Web search with page content
